summary: PO revision suffix appended after invoice upload causes allocation to previous PO revision and payrun GL mismatch
description:
Issue summary: Several vendor invoices uploaded on the 2026-03-01 payrun failed allocation because the PO in the invoice included a revision suffix (e.g., PO-4521-R2) created after the invoice was submitted. The AP matcher routed the allocation to PO-4521 (no suffix) which does not have matching line items for the current invoice, leaving the invoice unapplied and the payment blocked.

Impact: Blocked payment for 7 vendor invoices totaling $94,320 (two vendors). Next scheduled payrun (2026-03-02) flagged these invoices and they remained in 'Requires Manual Allocation' status, causing vendor escalation and a pending accounts reconciliation discrepancy for GL 2100-AP.

Scope: 7 invoices from vendor IDs VND-8844 and VND-9921; PO family affected: PO-4521 and PO-4521-R1/R2 revisions. This appears to be triggered when a PO is revised after an invoice has been created in the system but before automatic matching runs.
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Create PO PO-4521 with two lines (Line 1: HW-100 qty 10, Line 2: SW-200 qty 5).
2) Upload an invoice referencing PO-4521 (no suffix), matching quantities.
3) Revise PO to PO-4521-R1 then PO-4521-R2 and change quantities on Line 1.
4) Trigger automatic matching / allocation job (ap-matcher v2.3).
5) Observe allocation routed to PO-4521 (base) instead of PO-4521-R2 or flagged as mismatch; invoice remains unapplied or is partially applied to incorrect GL account.
logs: ap-matcher logs (2026-03-01 22:14:05 UTC): 'INFO: matching attempt: invoice INV-20260301-118 -> candidate PO-4521 (score 0.62) -> selected', then 'WARN: selected PO revision absent in canonical index: PO-4521-R2', payrun-service (2026-03-02 02:05:12 UTC): 'ERROR: allocation rejected - mismatch between invoice lines and PO line totals', bank-batch: N/A (payment not attempted). Full matcher trace posted to Slack thread #finance-helpdesk: https://slack.redwood.com/archives/C03FINANCE/p1643XXXXX
investigation_notes:
Initial hypothesis: ap-matcher lookup prefers base PO number when revision suffix is appended or when canonical PO index is stale. Found race condition: PO revision event updates canonical index asynchronously; invoice upload triggers matching against a cached PO index snapshot. Evidence: cache TTL for 'po-canonical-index' is 5 minutes, queue backlog on 2026-03-01 between 21:50-22:10 UTC (spike in PO revisions). Observed two flows: invoices that arrived during the backlog matched against the old index and were routed to PO-4521.

Temporary repro executed on staging with synthetic backlog and confirmed the misrouting under 4-7 minute index staleness. Additional note: allocation logic does not currently check for revision suffix equivalence or revision history when candidate score is borderline (score threshold 0.6).
comments: Support (Aisha): Ticket opened after vendor escalation. Attached sample invoices INV-20260301-118 and INV-20260301-122 and PO snapshots. Priority set to P2 since vendors are contacting AP team.

Accounting (J. Morales): Noted GL 2100-AP shows pending reversal entries for these invoices. We need a short-term manual remediation to apply these invoices to PO-4521-R2 to release payments in the next payrun.

SRE (Liam): Reproduced cache TTL race in staging. ap-matcher uses cached PO index in redis key 'po-canonical-index:v1'. When revisions are created under load, the reindex job falls behind.
Action: raising immediate mitigation — increase reindex frequency and add revision-aware fallback in matcher.
Support (Aisha): Customer-facing note drafted. Will notify vendors that invoices are under manual review and payments scheduled for next immediate run after allocation fix.
workaround: Manual allocation: AP team can run 'ap:manual-apply --invoice INV-20260301-118 --po PO-4521-R2 --force' from Finance Console (requires finance-admin role). Procedure documented in Confluence page. Recommended until matcher fix is deployed. Performed for 4/7 invoices; remaining 3 pending due to GL validation failures.
resolution:
In progress - short-term: AP performed manual allocations for 4 invoices to release two payments (VND-8844 paid via ad-hoc bank transfer). Medium-term: Engineering to deploy two changes: 1) reduce po-canonical-index TTL from 300s to 60s and add immediate reindex on PO revision events; 2) add revision-aware fallback to ap-matcher that, when candidate score is between 0.55 and 0.7, verifies PO revision history for recent revisions within 15 minutes.
Follow-up tasks: INT-778235 (engineering task) created to track the matcher code change and INT-778236 created for a postmortem to tune thresholds and monitoring. Deployment window agreed: 2026-03-05 03:00-04:00 UTC (low-impact).
postmortem_action_items: Add metric: 'ap-matcher:matches_against_stale_index' and alert if >1% in 5m window
Update runbook: include manual allocation CLI command and approval workflow
Add comprehensive test to matcher unit tests covering revision suffix behaviors
Backfill failed allocations and reconcile GL 2100-AP for 2026-03-01 payrun
